units.title: Create engine-contract-enforcer hook
units.description: PreToolUse hook that checks new/modified engine files for: (1) class extends BaseEngine or implements IEngine, (2) has execute() method, (3) has validate() method. Warns on violation, blocks after grace period (configurable via ARCH_GRACE_DATE env var or config). Grace period: existing 1,287 engines that don't adopt BaseEngine are exempt until date X. Only NEW engine files (created after the hook's install date) are blocked. Register in HookRegistry with test fixtures.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: Hook registered in HookRegistry
Fires on NEW engine file creation/modification
Correctly identifies non-compliant new engines
Does NOT fire on existing engines (grace period verified with date check)
3+ test cases: compliant new engine (pass), non-compliant new engine (block), existing engine (exempt)
Tests pass
tsc 0 errors

abort_criteria: Hook blocks edits to existing engines

units.title: Create shadow-data-detector + dispatcher-purity-checker + direct-io-blocker hooks
units.description: Three hooks: (1) shadow-data-detector: warns if engine defines >5 hardcoded records matching material/machine/tool data patterns (array of objects with properties like 'machinability', 'vc', 'fz', 'rpm', 'travel'). (2) dispatcher-purity-checker: warns if dispatcher file imports from registries/ path or has >20 LOC of non-routing code (heuristic: function definitions inside dispatcher). (3) direct-io-blocker: warns if non-exempt engine uses readFileSync/readFile — reads exempt list from state/ARCH-IO-CLASSIFICATION.md Category D list. All register in HookRegistry with 2+ test fixtures each.
